description: A field-service dispatcher board in the Svelte 5 data grid with every active job sorted by SLA. The Tech and Priority cells are list editors gated by the editable predicate so a finished job cannot be reassigned or bumped, a Today cell renders an inline striped timeline of received, en route, on site and resolved with segment lengths proportional to time spent, an SLA tone gauge flags urgency, and a right-hand panel shows each technician as a load gauge. A live stream emits status transitions and ETA shifts.

faq.question: How is a job reassigned?
faq.answer: Double-click the Tech cell and pick from the editorType list dropdown. The editable function returns false for jobs marked done, so those cells stay locked.

faq.question: How is the timeline cell built?
faq.answer: A cell snippet lays out one segment per state with a width proportional to the time in that state, using the job's timestamps; the current state's segment grows on each tick.

faq.question: How does the capacity panel stay accurate?
faq.answer: It is a $derived count of open jobs per technician over the same jobs array the grid renders, so a reassignment moves load between gauges immediately.
